High severity GitHub Reviewed Published Jan 8, 2026 in remix-run/react-router • Updated Jan 11, 2026

Vulnerability details Dependabot alerts 0

react-router (npm)

>= 7.0.0, <= 7.11.0

7.12.0

## Description

React Router (and Remix v1/v2) SPA open navigation redirects originating from loaders or actions in Framework Mode, Data Mode, or the unstable RSC modes can result in unsafe URLs causing unintended javascript execution on the client. This is only an issue if developers are creating redirect paths from untrusted content or via an open redirect.

Note

This does not impact applications that use Declarative Mode (`<BrowserRouter>`).

### References

  * GHSA-2w69-qvjg-hvjx

dvz published GHSA-wf92-5q5h-qr53 May 28, 2026

## Package

MyBB

## Affected versions

< 1.8.40

## Patched versions

1.8.40

## Description

### Impact

The Contact module does not validate the input URL or protocol correctly, resulting in an open redirect and JavaScript code injection (reflected XSS) vulnerability.

CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N

### Details

The `contact.php` component accepts the redirect URL from HTTP parameter `from` (`$mybb->input['from']`) or HTTP header `Referer` (`$_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER']`) that is passed to the `redirect()` function without sufficient verification.

In addition to the open redirect weakness, `javascript:` scheme URIs are accepted, resulting in a reflected XSS vulnerability. While browsers don't execute such payloads in redirection context, the URI is the target of the rendered Click here if you don't want to wait any longer link on the redirect page that is displayed regardless of settings or user preferences (`$force_redirect = true`).

`$redirect_url` population at https://github.com/mybb/mybb/blob/mybb_1839/contact.php#L294-L305
`redirect()` calls at https://github.com/mybb/mybb/blob/mybb_1839/contact.php#L248-L256

Introduced in MyBB 1.8.27 via #4063 (#4060)

### Patches

MyBB 1.8.40 resolves this issue with the following changes:

  * Commit: `04aa5da`
    * `.patch`: https://github.com/mybb/mybb/commit/04aa5da6ecd41c0e84456a733df8b28974f4e9db.patch

### References

  * Release Notes: https://mybb.com/versions/1.8.40/

### For more information

Go to mybb.com/security to report possible security concerns or to learn more about security research at MyBB.

### Contact

The security team can be reached at security@mybb.com.

### Severity

Moderate

### CVE ID

CVE-2026-45118

### Weaknesses

Weakness CWE-83

#### Improper Neutralization of Script in Attributes in a Web Page

The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes javascript: or other URIs from dangerous attributes within tags, such as onmouseover, onload, onerror, or style. Learn more on MITRE.

## A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in...

High severity Unreviewed Published Jan 15, 2026 to the GitHub Advisory Database • Updated Jan 15, 2026

## Package

No package listed— Suggest a package

## Affected versions

Unknown

## Patched versions

Unknown

## Description

A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Grafana caused by combining a client path traversal and open redirect. This allows attackers to redirect users to a website that hosts a frontend plugin that will execute arbitrary JavaScript. This vulnerability does not require editor permissions and if anonymous access is enabled, the XSS will work. If the Grafana Image Renderer plugin is installed, it is possible to exploit the open redirect to achieve a full read SSRF. The default Content-Security-Policy (CSP) in Grafana will block the XSS though the `connect-src` directive.
